text: 北京市人民政府印发《北京市“十五五”时期深化国际消费中心城市建设规划》，其中提到，加大新能源汽车推广力度。进一步完善二手车流通体系,促进二手车便利交易,推动交易市场标准化、规模化发展。优化维修、保险等服务供给,有序发展汽车改装、租赁、赛事及房车露营等汽车后市场消费。加快推进汽车流通消费改革试点,培育汽车消费新增长点。
text_en: The Beijing Municipal People's Government issued the Beijing Plan for Deepening the Development of an International Consumption Center City During the 15th Five-Year Plan Period, which mentions increasing efforts to promote new energy vehicles. It calls for further improving the used-car circulation system, facilitating convenient used-car transactions, and promoting the standardized and large-scale development of the trading market. It also calls for optimizing the supply of services such as maintenance and insurance, and developing in an orderly manner aftermarket auto consumption including vehicle modification, leasing, racing and RV camping. It calls for accelerating the pilot reform of automobile circulation and consumption and cultivating new growth points in auto consumption.
